summary: KudiAI Track is a business, savings and payments app for Nigerian small businesses, made by Amaya & Co. Technologies. Business owners record sales and expenses, see real profit, manage stock and debts, send invoices, get paid into their own wallet account number and pay bills. Ajo and Esusu collectors run digital savings cards and rotations, and their savers get their own portal and wallet. Staff and branches get their own logins. Every receipt carries a QR code anyone can verify at kudiai.app/verify.

faq: What is KudiAI Track?

KudiAI Track is a business, savings and payments app for Nigerian small businesses. It records sales and expenses, shows real profit, manages stock and debts, sends invoices, gives each business its own wallet account number for payments and bills, and runs Ajo and Esusu savings.
Who makes KudiAI Track?
KudiAI Track is made by Amaya & Co. Technologies (Amaya Technologies). The founder and CEO is Solomon Leon Johnson.
Is KudiAI Track free?
You can start on a free plan and upgrade when your business needs more.
Which languages does it support?
English, Nigerian Pidgin, Hausa, Igbo and Yoruba.
Does it work without internet?
Yes. Sales recorded offline are queued and sync automatically when your connection returns.
How do I check that a KudiAI receipt is real?
Scan the QR code on the receipt, or enter its reference at kudiai.app/verify. No login is needed.
Can my Ajo savers see their own savings?
Yes. Each saver can have their own login to see their savings card, contributions and statements, and to use their own KudiAI wallet.
How is my money protected?
Every transfer from a wallet needs your transaction PIN, the app has its own lock PIN, and wallet limits are tied to identity checks (BVN and NIN).
What phone do I need?
Any smartphone with a web browser. Open kudiai.app; on iPhone you can add it to your Home Screen.
How do I contact support?
Email support@kudiai.app.
